title: M Tool Account
author: Theara
changelog: Fix the Move To category menu crash caused by accessing a deleted Qt menu. Keep category lists fresh on each right-click and move all selected accounts. Includes the latest account tool fixes through 3.5.56: thread settings, browser reuse, cookie-first session handling, and improved pending/checkpoint classification. Preserve accounts, settings, and custom browser profile folders during updates. Automated sample and startup checks passed; live-account workflow acceptance remains unverified.
